The setup rewards patience, as the current sideways regime is less about direction and more about waiting for the liquidity squeeze to resolve.
brain_consensus.headline: Dollar Fades, Gold Shines, Bitcoin Coils

Factor momentum is mixed — risk-on drivers (DXY weakness, gold strength, VIX elevation) suggest eventual upside escape, but fed_liquidity at 0 and retail_noise_volume at 100 with velocity at 30 show trapped, churning energy without directional release. For DOWN: VIX spike above 80 with exchange_netflow flipping positive (reserves 77, netflow 19 means accumulation, but if netflow rises with reserves falling = distribution). Neither breaker is live.
